weapons.name: Rusted Blade
weapons.description: A salvaged edge. Pitted with rust, still sharp enough to cut.

weapons.name: Mud-Rend Blade
weapons.description: A field-forged blade with a serrated spine for tearing through mud-glass crust. Reclaimer salvage crews favour it for cutting siltbound straps and wraith-flesh both.

weapons.name: Mud-Iron Cleaver
weapons.description: A heavy single-edged blade cast from mud-iron. Crude balance but it carries weight through the swing.

weapons.name: Mud-fist Wraps
weapons.description: Hardened mud-glass strapped over knuckles. Hurts more than it should.

weapons.name: Club
weapons.description: A length of dry wood, fist-thick. Crude but it breaks bones honestly. Splinters fast.
weapons.effect: Grants +5 HP.

weapons.name: Cudgel
weapons.description: A stick with a fat stone lashed to its head with rag. Slow swing, heavy landing. The lashing loosens.
weapons.effect: Grants +5 HP.

weapons.name: Stone Spear
weapons.description: A stick with a chipped rock lashed to its point. Crude but it reaches. The stone shatters on the first solid hit.
weapons.effect: Grants +5 HP.

weapons.name: Iron Spear
weapons.description: A salvaged-iron head on a wooden shaft. A real spear — keeps enemies at arm's length or buries itself in their chest. Won't last forever.

weapons.name: Aether-Shard Spear
weapons.effect: +1d4 aetheric damage against aetheric or magical targets.
weapons.description: An Aetheric shard bound to a hardwood shaft. Hums faintly. Cuts cleaner than iron — and the shard's energy survives the wood.

weapons.name: Pocket Knife
weapons.description: A folding pocket knife. Cuts, peels, and — in this country — digs. Doesn't survive heavy work.

weapons.name: Bone Shiv
weapons.description: Mud Dweller workshop output — an Aetheric-treated bone splinter, ground to a point. Brittle but very, very sharp.

weapons.name: Reclaimer's Trowel
weapons.description: A flat hand-trowel with a sharpened lip. Standard Reclaimer kit — used like an archaeologist's blade: point-first, deliberate, never destructive.

weapons.name: Order Letter-Opener
weapons.description: An Order scholar's letter-opener. Steel, slim, surprisingly stab-able.

weapons.name: Salvaged Bow
weapons.description: A bone-wood bow re-strung with spider silk. Quiet and serviceable.

weapons.name: Pyric Wand
weapons.description: A short rod with an Aetheric core. Spits a thumb-sized gout of flame on command.

weapons.name: Aetheric Crystal Blade
weapons.description: Slag-cast Aetherstone hilted in mud-bone. Cuts cloth and Aetheric haze alike.

weapons.name: Tartarian Spear
weapons.description: A spear forged from pre-flood iron. Balanced for throw or thrust.

weapons.name: Storm Rod
weapons.description: A rod that bleeds blue arcs to anything Aether-touched within close range.

weapons.name: Bone Crossbow
weapons.description: Compact, mud-treated, fires bone bolts that retain their edge in Aetheric weather. Tartaria's everyday bolt-caster — the buried-world firearm.

weapons.name: Bolt-Caster
weapons.description: A spring-loaded Reclaimer carbine — mud-resistant, single-bolt action, fires Aether-tempered bolts. The closest Tartaria has to a rifle. Reloads one bolt at a time unless you take the full action to swap magazines.

weapons.name: Aether Bolt-Caster
weapons.description: A Forgotten Order experimental bolt-caster, its bolts plated with raw Aetherstone. Burns the target on hit. Heats the wielder's hand if fired more than three times in a row.

weapons.name: Sentinel Cleaver
weapons.description: Repurposed plate from a fallen Sentinel, ground to an edge. Heavier than it looks.

weapons.name: Aetherstone Gauntlet
weapons.description: A gauntlet cored with Aetherstone. Every strike pulses a concussive ring.
weapons.effect: Grants +15 HP.

weapons.name: Mire Stave
weapons.description: A stave carved from bog-iron, beaded with Aetheric venom. The air sours around it.

weapons.name: Founder's Edge
weapons.description: Said to have been carried by one of Tartaria's first builders. Cuts through Aetheric haze like it isn't there.

weapons.name: Crown of Verdict
weapons.description: A crown of dim-pulsing Aetherstone. Renders judgment in light older than language.

weapons.name: Rust Rifle
weapons.effect: Old, unreliable — may jam on a natural 1 attack roll (even/odd reroll to confirm jam).
weapons.description: A salvaged pre-flood long-arm, more rust than rifle. Fires once if you're lucky.

weapons.name: Bone Maul
weapons.description: Heavy bone maul with a large crack down the haft. No effects, just weight.
weapons.effect: Grants +5 HP.

weapons.name: Mud Long Axe
weapons.effect: Bonus action — trip enemies on a max damage roll.
weapons.description: A long-hafted axe with a hardened mud-glass head. Trips as well as it cleaves.

weapons.name: Repeater Crossbow
weapons.effect: Fires 2 bolts per round; needs 1 round to reload.
weapons.description: Twin-barreled bone crossbow with a hand-crank reload. Reliable if you give it time.

weapons.name: Mud Harpoon
weapons.description: Heavy harpoon set on a long pole. No frills — just point and push.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Longbow
weapons.effect: +1d6 damage to creatures of Large size. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: A bow drawn from a Giant's femur. Pulls heavy, fires far.

weapons.name: Mud Sledge
weapons.description: Standard large sledge carved from hardened mud. Heavy work, heavier hit.
weapons.effect: Grants +10 HP.

weapons.name: Mud Grinder Axe
weapons.effect: Causes bleed (1d6 / turn for 2 turns) on expert usage.
weapons.description: Toothed mud-glass head designed to grind through armor and meat alike.

weapons.name: Mud Mauler
weapons.description: Large maul made from hardened mud filled with building remnants. Crude. Effective.
weapons.effect: Grants +5 HP.

weapons.name: Rail Saber
weapons.description: Tech-era energy blade. The hum is louder than the cut.

weapons.name: Aetherium Spear
weapons.effect: +1d6 damage against mechanical enemies or weapons.
weapons.description: Aether-veined spear, glows where the haft meets the head.

weapons.name: Repeater Rifle
weapons.description: Single shot per turn, reliable. The basic long-arm of the buried world.

weapons.name: Bone Splitter Axe
weapons.effect: Splits shields on a max roll.
weapons.description: Wedge-shaped axe head built specifically to wreck guards.

weapons.name: Bonebreaker Mace
weapons.description: Giant-forged mace, the head as wide as a man's chest.
weapons.effect: Grants +5 HP.

weapons.name: Mud Claymore
weapons.description: Two-handed mud-iron sword. Reach matters more than finesse.

weapons.name: Aetheric Pike
weapons.description: Long pike with an Aether-charged tip. Hold the line.

weapons.name: Mud War Pike
weapons.effect: Enemies hit must make a Strength save or be pushed back 10 feet.
weapons.description: Brutal pike with a wide spreading guard — built to break a charge.

weapons.name: Aetheric Greatsword
weapons.effect: +1 to grip usage while in your possession.
weapons.description: Aether-charged greatsword. Hums steady in the hand.

weapons.name: Titan Warhammer
weapons.effect: +1d6 damage against structures or vehicles. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Giant-forged warhammer with a head the size of a kettle drum.

weapons.name: Aetheric Halberd
weapons.description: Aether-veined halberd. Reaches further than it looks.

weapons.name: Heavy Aetheric Flail
weapons.effect: Automatically wins attack rolls against Aetherkin.
weapons.description: Aether-cored flail. The chain hums when the Veil is thin.

weapons.name: Plasma Repeater Rifle
weapons.effect: Rapid plasma — natural 1 triggers an overheat reroll. After 4 overheats it explodes (1d10 to everyone in your range).
weapons.description: Pre-flood plasma weapon. Fast. Hot. Unstable.

weapons.name: Magnetized Halberd
weapons.effect: Pulls metallic objects toward the wielder.
weapons.description: Aether-magnetized polearm. The air around it tugs at iron.

weapons.name: Bone Harpoon Launcher
weapons.description: Fires large bone harpoons. Slow to reload, brutal to receive.

weapons.name: Mud Spear (Throwing)
weapons.effect: Can be thrown to far range from any other.
weapons.description: A hardened mud-glass spear, balanced for the long throw.

weapons.name: Tartarian Siege Bow
weapons.effect: +1d6 damage to machines.
weapons.description: Heavy bone composite bow. Built for siege work.

weapons.name: Aetheric Cross-Saber
weapons.effect: +1d6 damage to energy-based enemies.
weapons.description: Cross-guarded saber with Aether-traced fullers. Hums against the Veil.

weapons.name: Plasma Scythe
weapons.effect: Ignores armor on max damage roll once per encounter (declinable, save for later).
weapons.description: Crescent of plasma on a long shaft. Cuts the way the Aether wills.

weapons.name: Bone Siege Crossbow
weapons.effect: Pierces armor; only energy armor resists.
weapons.description: Massive bone crossbow built to puncture plate.

weapons.name: Bone Cleaver
weapons.effect: Even/odd reroll to stun the enemy after each use.
weapons.description: Bone-bladed cleaver, weighty and wide. Stuns as often as it kills.

weapons.name: Aetheric Shield-Hammer
weapons.effect: +2 AC for 1 round after a hit. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Hammer with a wide guard that doubles as a shield face.

weapons.name: Aether Lance
weapons.effect: Disrupts energy shields; +1d6 against energy-shielded targets.
weapons.description: Lance with an Aether-channel running its length. Eats shields.

weapons.name: Aetheric Pike (Rare)
weapons.effect: Fires an energy projectile at any range; +1d6 vs affiliated foes.
weapons.description: Rare-grade Aether pike that throws its head as energy and reforms it.

weapons.name: Rail Cannon
weapons.effect: Requires 1 round to charge; deals 1d6 as a club while charging.
weapons.description: Pre-flood railgun. Charges with a whine you feel in your teeth.

weapons.name: High-Impact Blaster
weapons.description: Heavy energy weapon. No frills, just punch.

weapons.name: Magna-Cannon
weapons.effect: Explosive rounds — same 1d10 AoE damage to enemies or allies in arm's reach of target.
weapons.description: Bulky shoulder cannon. Cleans rooms — your room included.

weapons.name: Heavy Plasma Hammer
weapons.effect: +1d6 Aetheric damage to any target with no Aetheric gear / weapons / items.
weapons.description: Plasma-cored warhammer. Punishes the unprepared.

weapons.name: Fusion Greatsword
weapons.effect: +1d6 fire damage on max roll; causes burns.
weapons.description: Greatsword that bleeds plasma along its fuller.

weapons.name: Railgun Pike
weapons.effect: +1d6 vs mechanical traps or machines.
weapons.description: Polearm with a railgun core. Fires its tip on command.

weapons.name: Titan Bone Axe
weapons.effect: +1d6 against structures. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Axe ground from a Titan's femur. Carries the weight of the species.

weapons.name: Gravity Hammer
weapons.effect: Knock-stun enemies in same range as you (even/odd reroll to confirm). Grants +20 HP.
weapons.description: Hammer that drags the air with it. The world dips when it falls.

weapons.name: Plasma Warhammer
weapons.effect: +1d6 bludgeoning damage to Large-size enemies. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Plasma-vented warhammer. The head sings on impact.

weapons.name: Aetheric Spear (Legendary)
weapons.effect: +1d6 against energy shields.
weapons.description: Apex Aether spear. Disjoint between physical and energy fades around it.

weapons.name: Gravity Pike
weapons.effect: Alters gravity, slowing the target; companions rolling later get advantage.
weapons.description: Pike whose head warps the gravitic field around the target.

weapons.name: Heavy Rail Axe
weapons.effect: +1d6 shock damage.
weapons.description: Rail-charged battle axe. The head arcs blue on the swing.

weapons.name: Energy Pike
weapons.effect: Fires energy blasts (assigned damage roll) or melee to stun (even = stun for 3 turns).
weapons.description: Pike of contained plasma. Ranged threat as well as melee.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Spear
weapons.effect: Advantage on all attacks vs giants and golems. +2 STR (permanent) on 5th max roll; does not stack.
weapons.description: Bone spear carved from a Titan's shin. Reads the species it was made from.

weapons.name: Shockwave Club
weapons.effect: Emits shockwave on max roll — knocks back enemies 1 range band. Grants +20 HP.
weapons.description: Massive Aether-cored club. Lands like an earthquake.

weapons.name: Mud Army War Hammer
weapons.effect: Close-in shockwave on max roll; +2d10 to everything in arm's reach radius. Even/odd reroll to suppress the effect for one attack. Grants +25 HP.
weapons.description: Banner-weapon of the Mud Army. The world hears it land.

weapons.name: Rust Dagger
weapons.effect: Breaks on any parry attempt.
weapons.description: Cheap mud-iron dagger. Fragile, sharp, expendable.

weapons.name: Mud Buckler
weapons.description: Small wooden buckler. Will block one good hit, maybe.
weapons.effect: Grants +10 HP.

weapons.name: Bone Knife
weapons.description: Knife carved from animal bone. Standard Giant tool.

weapons.name: Aetheric Rod
weapons.effect: +1 damage to tech.
weapons.description: Short Aether-charged rod. Bites at metal.

weapons.name: Tartarian Hand Axe
weapons.effect: 1 damage reroll per encounter.
weapons.description: Throwable hand axe. Hammered from old Tartarian alloy.

weapons.name: Compact Blaster
weapons.description: Glowing derringer-style blaster. Pocket-sized, palm-warm.

weapons.name: Mud Shortsword
weapons.effect: Close-range 50% chance to stun (even/odd 1d6 to confirm).
weapons.description: Stubby mud-iron sword. The grip is wrapped in old leather.

weapons.name: Iron Buckler
weapons.effect: Can bash for 1d4; does not count as attack move. Grants +10 HP.
weapons.description: Round iron buckler. Cheap, dented, dependable.

weapons.name: Plasma Dagger
weapons.effect: +5 Aetheric damage on max roll.
weapons.description: Energy-edged dagger. The blade is a thin slice of contained plasma.

weapons.name: Bone Shiv (Stealth)
weapons.effect: +1 to Stealth.
weapons.description: Slim bone shiv shaped for the quiet kill.

weapons.name: Tartarian Claw Knife
weapons.effect: +4 damage against creatures with natural armor.
weapons.description: Curved bone knife. Designed to find seams in scaled hides.

weapons.name: Mud Heater Shield
weapons.effect: +2 AC vs fire damage. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Tall heater-style shield, layered with fire-treated mud.

weapons.name: Aetheric Dagger
weapons.description: Aether-tempered dagger. Clean, quick, quiet.

weapons.name: Bone Round Shield
weapons.effect: +2 AC; can bash for 1d6. Grants +20 HP.
weapons.description: Heavy bone round shield. Doubles as a battering edge.

weapons.name: High-Frequency Dagger
weapons.effect: Ignores non-Aetheric armor; 50% chance to disarm (1d6 even/odd).
weapons.description: Vibro-edge dagger. The hum is barely audible.

weapons.name: Aetheric Shield
weapons.effect: Deflects energy attacks; +2 AC vs energy damage. Grants +20 HP.
weapons.description: Aether-cored shield. Eats energy bolts and stays cool.

weapons.name: Mud Spiked Shield
weapons.effect: Deals 1d6 damage on the block. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Mud-glass shield with hammered spikes. Hits back.

weapons.name: Plasma Shield
weapons.effect: Blocks Aetheric-based damage; reduces blunt force by 1d6. Grants +20 HP.
weapons.description: Translucent plasma shield. Hums on impact.

weapons.name: Bone Scimitar
weapons.effect: +1d6 on max roll.
weapons.description: Curved bone blade, edged in flake-glass.

weapons.name: Laser Blade
weapons.effect: Cuts through metal; +1d6 against armor.
weapons.description: Slim laser-edge blade. Steady hum, clean cut.

weapons.name: Mud Kukri
weapons.effect: Reduces enemy armor by 1d6 on max roll.
weapons.description: Heavy curved blade with a forward-weighted edge.

weapons.name: Energy Baton
weapons.effect: Stuns target on max roll (1 round).
weapons.description: Short Aether baton. Sparks at the tip.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Shield
weapons.effect: +3 AC; reduces incoming slashing by 1d6. Grants +25 HP.
weapons.description: Giant-bone shield, the size of a small door.

weapons.name: Plasma Handgun
weapons.effect: Natural 1 → overheat, useless 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Compact energy pistol. Light, hot, finicky.

weapons.name: Tartarian Warblade
weapons.effect: +1d6 against Large creatures.
weapons.description: Giant-bone blade with a Tartarian guard. Built for the open.

weapons.name: Shockwave Buckler
weapons.effect: Shockwave on max-roll block — push enemies to far distance. Grants +15 HP.
weapons.description: Aether-cored buckler. Releases concussive ring on solid contact.

weapons.name: Aetheric Plasma Blade
weapons.effect: +1d20 to all in close range if broken on parry.
weapons.description: Volatile plasma blade. Goes out in a flash if it breaks.

weapons.name: Graviton Shield
weapons.effect: Absorbs impact; +1d6 environmental damage reduction. Grants +30 HP.
weapons.description: Graviton-skinned shield. Drags the bow of incoming force.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Knuckles
weapons.effect: +1d6 to arm's-reach targets. Grants +10 HP.
weapons.description: Heavy bone knuckles fitted to a clenched fist.

weapons.name: Shock Gauntlet
weapons.effect: Stuns on max roll (1 round).
weapons.description: Plated gauntlet with Aether-stacked knuckles. Electrifies on impact.

weapons.name: Plasma Buckler
weapons.effect: Reflects 1d6 plasma damage back at attacker on max roll. Grants +20 HP.
weapons.description: Buckler with a plasma surface. Mirrors energy attacks.

weapons.name: Mud Thornblade
weapons.effect: +1d6 poison damage to unarmored enemies for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Hooked blade with thornlike serration. Carries Mud Dweller venom.

weapons.name: Aetheric Hand Axe
weapons.effect: 50% chance to paralyze for 2 rounds (1d6 even/odd).
weapons.description: Aether-veined hand axe. The strike paralyzes more often than it bleeds.

weapons.name: Tartarian Great Knife
weapons.effect: +1d6 to armor or structures.
weapons.description: Oversized bone knife. Built to defeat plate.

weapons.name: Plasma Pistol
weapons.effect: 50% enemy HP loss on rolls of 20+.
weapons.description: Concentrated plasma pistol. Each round is a small star.

weapons.name: Titan Shield
weapons.effect: +4 AC; blocks +1d6 from physical attacks. Grants +35 HP.
weapons.description: Titan-bone shield, taller than most Reclaimers.

weapons.name: Mud Venom Blade
weapons.effect: 1d6 poison damage over 2 turns on rolls of 15+.
weapons.description: Slim mud-blade tipped with refined Mud Dweller venom.

weapons.name: Aetheric Sword of Light
weapons.effect: +1d6 against Mud Aether weapon users.
weapons.description: Light-bladed sword. The blade is shaped, not solid.

weapons.name: Tartarian Bone Cleaver
weapons.effect: +1d6 bleed damage on hit.
weapons.description: Bone cleaver with a Giant's brand on the hilt.

weapons.name: Energy Blade (Legendary)
weapons.effect: Cuts through any armor; ignores non-magical defenses.
weapons.description: Pure energy blade in a graphene haft.

weapons.name: Mud Royal Shield
weapons.effect: Deflects runecasters / powers once per day; +3 AC. Grants +50 HP.
weapons.description: Banner-shield of the Mud Royal Guard. Etched with old glyphs.

weapons.name: Graviton Gauntlet
weapons.effect: Slows enemy movement by 10 ft on hit.
weapons.description: Graviton-cored gauntlet. Hits drag the world with them.

weapons.name: Tartarian Crown Blade
weapons.effect: +1d6 on all max roll hits.
weapons.description: Crown-rank Giant blade. Earned, not given.

weapons.name: Plasma Energy Shield
weapons.effect: Blocks all plasma damage; reflects 1d6 back. Grants +30 HP.
weapons.description: Plasma-screen shield. Eats fire, throws fire back.

weapons.name: Aetheric Arm Blade
weapons.effect: +1d6 against constructs.
weapons.description: Forearm-mounted Aether blade. Strikes faster than the hand it covers.

weapons.name: Mud Emperor's Buckler
weapons.effect: +3 AC; reflects up to 1d6 back at attacker. Grants +40 HP.
weapons.description: Buckler of the Mud Emperor's honor guard.

weapons.name: Plasma Cutter Knife
weapons.effect: Melts through armor; 1d6 burning damage.
weapons.description: Industrial cutter repurposed as a fighting knife.

weapons.name: Rusty Shortsword
weapons.effect: -1 to attack after each fight.
weapons.description: Cheap mud-iron shortsword. Holds an edge for one fight, maybe two.

weapons.name: Bone Club
weapons.effect: +1 to Coercion. Grants +5 HP.
weapons.description: Knotted bone club. Conversations end faster around it.

weapons.name: Tartarian Bone Knife
weapons.effect: +1d6 against natural armor.
weapons.description: Ceremonial bone knife. Cuts hide cleanly.

weapons.name: Mud Knife
weapons.effect: Chance to inflict 1d4 bleed.
weapons.description: Standard mud-iron utility knife. Cuts more than rope.

weapons.name: Plasma Cutter
weapons.effect: Rolls of 19+ count as max roll.
weapons.description: Industrial precision cutter. Energy edge, surgeon's grip.

weapons.name: Tartarian Hand Axe (Throw)
weapons.effect: Throwable to Close range.
weapons.description: Balanced for the hurl as well as the swing.

weapons.name: Aetheric Baton
weapons.effect: +1 damage to mechanical creatures.
weapons.description: Aether-charged baton. Snaps blue against metal.

weapons.name: Compact Energy Blade
weapons.effect: Ignores 1 armor point on hit.
weapons.description: Short energy blade. Stable, small, hot.

weapons.name: Mud Heater Sword
weapons.effect: +1d6 against cold creatures.
weapons.description: Mud-iron sword with a heated core. Stays warm in the cold.

weapons.name: Bone Shortsword
weapons.effect: +1 to parry when used with shields.
weapons.description: Bone-bladed shortsword. Pairs well with a buckler.

weapons.name: Magnetized Rod
weapons.effect: Pulls metallic objects toward the wielder.
weapons.description: Aether-magnetized rod. Tugs at iron from a distance.

weapons.name: Energy Blade
weapons.effect: Cuts non-magical armor; +1d6 on max roll.
weapons.description: Solid Aether-blade in a quick-draw sheath.

weapons.name: Bone Sword
weapons.effect: +1d6 to Large creatures.
weapons.description: Bone-bladed sword. The cross-guard is a Titan's tooth.

weapons.name: Mud Cleaver
weapons.effect: Reduces enemy armor by 1 on hit.
weapons.description: Heavy mud-cleaver. Splits as much as it cuts.

weapons.name: Plasma Knife
weapons.effect: +1d6 plasma damage on hit.
weapons.description: Slim plasma knife. Cuts air, then armor, then meat.

weapons.name: Aetheric Blade
weapons.effect: +1d6 Aetheric; bypasses non-magical defenses.
weapons.description: Aether-edged sword. Passes through what it shouldn't.

weapons.name: Tartarian War Knife
weapons.effect: +1d6 against constructs.
weapons.description: Long bone knife with a serrated back. Built for Aetherkin.

weapons.name: Mud Saber
weapons.effect: Reduces enemy speed by 10 ft on hit.
weapons.description: Curved mud-iron saber. Hooks tendons.

weapons.name: Compact Laser Pistol
weapons.effect: Ignores light armor.
weapons.description: Pocket laser. Light enough to forget you're carrying.

weapons.name: Mud Bone Sword
weapons.effect: +1d6 bleed on hit.
weapons.description: Sharp bone blade. The edge is shaved to a hair.

weapons.name: Plasma Pistol (Single)
weapons.effect: Fires twice per round.
weapons.description: Single-hand plasma pistol. Twin-shot trigger group.

weapons.name: Bone Thornblade
weapons.effect: +1d6 poison damage on hit.
weapons.description: Hooked bone blade slicked with refined toxin.

weapons.name: Energy Saber
weapons.effect: Emits energy pulse on hit.
weapons.description: High-tech saber. The crossguard pulses when it lands.

weapons.name: Giant Warblade
weapons.effect: Damage to all enemies in same range on max roll.
weapons.description: Heavy single-handed blade. Sweeps wide on the kill stroke.

weapons.name: Plasma Mace
weapons.effect: +1d6 plasma damage.
weapons.description: Mace with a plasma-cored head. Lands wet.

weapons.name: Aetheric Blade of Light
weapons.effect: +1d6 against creatures of darkness.
weapons.description: Shaped-light blade. Sheds glow in a slow pulse.

weapons.name: Mud Venom Blade (Rare)
weapons.effect: +1d6 poison over 2 turns.
weapons.description: Rare-tier venom blade. The poison is the point.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Spear (Single)
weapons.effect: +1d6 to structures.
weapons.description: Massive bone spear, balanced for one-hand work.

weapons.name: Magnetic Axe
weapons.effect: Pulls metallic enemies 10 ft closer on hit.
weapons.description: Magnetic-cored axe. Drags armored foes toward you.

weapons.name: Laser Sword
weapons.effect: +1d6 energy; ignores non-magical armor.
weapons.description: Laser-edged single-handed sword. Crisp cut.

weapons.name: Aetheric Hand Cannon
weapons.effect: Natural 1 → overload: 1d6 self damage, useless 2 turns.
weapons.description: Compact Aether cannon. Single mighty shot.

weapons.name: Mud Executioner's Blade
weapons.effect: +1d6 on max roll; bleed (1d6/turn × 2).
weapons.description: Heavy executioner's blade. Used on rebels, traitors, oath-breakers.

weapons.name: Plasma Hand Cannon
weapons.effect: Permanent +1 STR on first max roll.
weapons.description: Hand-cannon of contained plasma. The kick builds you.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Sword
weapons.effect: +1d6 against armored enemies.
weapons.description: Giant-bone longsword fitted to a Reclaimer's grip.

weapons.name: Mud Emperor's Saber
weapons.effect: Bleed (1d6 × 2 rounds); reduces enemy armor.
weapons.description: Royal-tier saber of the Mud Emperor. Hooked at the tip.

weapons.name: Energy Hammer
weapons.effect: +1d6 shock damage.
weapons.description: Single-handed energy hammer. The head arcs on landing.

weapons.name: Aetheric Sword of Storms
weapons.effect: Max roll calls a storm — 1d10 AoE Close range (allies included).
weapons.description: Storm-bound blade. The sky listens to the swing.

weapons.name: Plasma Executioner's Axe
weapons.effect: +1d6 energy; bypasses shield on max rolls.
weapons.description: Plasma-edged executioner's axe. The shield-breaker.

weapons.name: Tartarian Crown Sword
weapons.effect: +1d6 against supernatural creatures.
weapons.description: Ancient blade of the Giant crown. Hums when the Veil tears.

weapons.name: Aetheric Deathblade
weapons.effect: Instantly kills enemies on max roll if HP below 20.
weapons.description: Aether blade with a cold, listening edge.

weapons.name: Mud Royal Blade
weapons.effect: Poison (1d6/turn); reduces enemy armor by 2.
weapons.description: Royal Mud blade, etched with the venom recipe.

weapons.name: Plasma Destroyer
weapons.effect: 1d6 splash damage to nearby enemies on hit.
weapons.description: Hand-held plasma destroyer. Each shot blossoms.

weapons.name: Mud Throwing Knife
weapons.effect: Short range; poor performance in rain.
weapons.description: Cheap mud-iron throwing knife. Comes in sets of six.

weapons.name: Throwing Knife
weapons.effect: Short range; weighted for tumble-throw.
weapons.description: Plain steel throwing knife. Drifter's standard — light, balanced, single piece.

weapons.name: Bone Sling
weapons.effect: Throws stones/bones; reduced range in wind.
weapons.description: Leather sling on a bone handle. Old craft, still works.

weapons.name: Rusty Shortbow
weapons.effect: Reduced range in bad weather; may jam in mud.
weapons.description: Old shortbow that's seen too many seasons.

weapons.name: Tartarian Hand Spear
weapons.effect: Short-range; chance to pin target.
weapons.description: Short throwing spear with a hooked head.

weapons.name: Compact Laser Pistol (Ranged)
weapons.effect: Loses accuracy in extreme cold.
weapons.description: Compact laser pistol. Battery whines in the cold.

weapons.name: Bone Javelin
weapons.effect: Longer throw than a knife; high wind reduces accuracy.
weapons.description: Bone javelin balanced for the standing throw.

weapons.name: Mud Sling
weapons.effect: +1d6 against glass or fragile objects.
weapons.description: Mud-leather sling. Throws lead, glass, or anything heavy.

weapons.name: Plasma Thrower
weapons.effect: Short range; rain reduces damage by 1d6.
weapons.description: Short-range plasma thrower. The flame is blue.

weapons.name: Short Hunting Bow
weapons.effect: Loses effectiveness in high wind. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Standard hunting bow. Reliable in still air.

weapons.name: Aetheric Bolt Gun
weapons.effect: Accuracy drops in dense fog.
weapons.description: Aether bolt gun. Pocket-sized energy weapon.

weapons.name: Bone Throwing Axe
weapons.effect: May cause 1d6 bleed over 2 turns; short range.
weapons.description: Bone throwing axe with a weighted head.

weapons.name: Mud Darts
weapons.effect: Poisoned; weather does not affect effectiveness.
weapons.description: Set of poisoned darts. Light, sharp, reliable.

weapons.name: Laser Crossbow
weapons.effect: Accuracy unaffected by weather. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Crossbow that fires energy bolts. Light, low recoil.

weapons.name: Aetheric Longbow
weapons.effect: Ignores wind conditions. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Aether-strung longbow. The arrow trails violet.

weapons.name: Plasma Spear
weapons.effect: Short range; +1d6 plasma damage.
weapons.description: Plasma-headed throwing spear. Sticks where it lands.

weapons.name: Giant Bone Bow
weapons.effect: Long-range; +1d6 to Large creatures.
weapons.description: Massive composite bow built for Giant draw.

weapons.name: Mud Repeater Crossbow
weapons.effect: Fires 3 bolts per round; reduced reload in rain.
weapons.description: Triple-bolt mud-crossbow. Spits hard, reloads slow.

weapons.name: Tartarian Spear (Throw)
weapons.effect: Long throw; accuracy drops in wind.
weapons.description: Heavy throwing spear, balanced for distance.

weapons.name: Energy Thrower
weapons.effect: Throws plasma grenades; loses power in extreme cold.
weapons.description: Grenade launcher that throws plasma fruit.

weapons.name: Bone War Javelin
weapons.effect: Long range; 1d6 bleed to Large creatures.
weapons.description: War javelin made of Titan bone. Sticks in.

weapons.name: Aetheric Throwing Disk
weapons.effect: Returns to wielder on miss; unaffected by wind.
weapons.description: Aether-disk. Hisses through the air, comes back to your hand.

weapons.name: Plasma Rifle
weapons.effect: Long-range; 1d6 splash on hit. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Pre-flood plasma rifle. Service issue, well-cared-for.

weapons.name: Mud Hunting Rifle
weapons.effect: +1d6 against animals; reduced accuracy in rain.
weapons.description: Mud-iron hunting rifle. Bolt action, oiled grip.

weapons.name: Aetheric Bow
weapons.effect: +1d6 against magical creatures.
weapons.description: Aether-strung composite bow. Sings on the draw.

weapons.name: Plasma Cannon
weapons.effect: Long-range; 1d6 splash damage.
weapons.description: Shoulder-fired plasma cannon. Cleans rooms.

weapons.name: Tartarian Longbow
weapons.effect: +1d6 to constructs or armor. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Heavy Giant longbow. Each shot a small spear.

weapons.name: Bone Spear Launcher
weapons.effect: Bypasses shields permanently on third max roll.
weapons.description: Crank-fed bone spear launcher. Devastating at close range.

weapons.name: Mud Harpoon Gun
weapons.effect: Pins enemies in place for 1 round.
weapons.description: Mud-flood harpoon gun. Used in the Sea, useful elsewhere.

weapons.name: Aetheric Pulse Rifle
weapons.effect: Ignores 2 armor points. +1d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Aether pulse rifle. Energy bolts pop through plate.

weapons.name: Plasma Long Rifle
weapons.effect: +1d6 in extreme heat.
weapons.description: Long-barrel plasma rifle. Precision sniper.

weapons.name: Aetheric Sniper Bow
weapons.effect: Ignores cover; unaffected by weather. +2d6 against airborne enemies.
weapons.description: Aether sniper bow. Picks off targets across stretches.

weapons.name: Tartarian Siege Bow (Legendary)
weapons.effect: +1d6 to structures; ignores armor.
weapons.description: Legendary-tier Giant siege bow. Brings walls down.

weapons.name: Plasma Burst Rifle
weapons.effect: Ignores shields on advantage rolls.
weapons.description: Burst-fire plasma rifle. Each pull empties three bolts.

weapons.name: Mud Emperor's Harpoon
weapons.effect: Pins enemies for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Royal-grade harpoon launcher. Pins what it punches.

weapons.name: Aetheric Railgun
weapons.effect: Ignores armor; long range.
weapons.description: Aether-charged railgun. The bolt is a streak of bent air.

weapons.name: Plasma Artillery Cannon
weapons.effect: Explosive plasma rounds; 1d6 splash on hit.
weapons.description: Heavy plasma artillery. Two-person carry, one-person fire.

weapons.name: Aetheric Spark
weapons.effect: Minor arcane damage. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: A pocket-sized runecaster that snaps Aetheric sparks at the touch.

weapons.name: Mud Grip
weapons.effect: Immobilizes a single target in mud (restrained, 3 rounds).
weapons.description: Squat clay runecaster — when squeezed, a target's feet sink into reaching mud.

weapons.name: Lightfoot Dash
weapons.effect: Caster moves at 2× speed for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Wind-carved runecaster. Quickens the foot, blurs the step.

weapons.name: Dust Cloud
weapons.effect: Creates a small dust cloud for cover. 1 round.
weapons.description: Powdered-clay runecaster. Throws a screen of dust at the snap.

weapons.name: Aetheric Touch
weapons.effect: Restores 1d6 HP to a target. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: A warm runecaster — knits small wounds when pressed to skin.

weapons.name: Mud Spray
weapons.effect: Sprays mud to blind enemies. 1d6 damage + blinded 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Mud-filled spray runecaster. Aim, squeeze, blind.

weapons.name: Slick Mud
weapons.effect: Creates slippery ground; DEX save or fall. 5 rounds.
weapons.description: Greased-clay runecaster. Turns stone into something footing can't trust.

weapons.name: Minor Repair
weapons.effect: Repairs Tartarian tech. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: A patchwork runecaster — bends Aether toward broken metal.

weapons.name: Vine Grasp
weapons.effect: Summons vines to entangle (restrained, 3 rounds).
weapons.description: Twisted root-bound runecaster. Calls vines up through silt.

weapons.name: Mud Shell
weapons.effect: Shields caster with mud barrier; blocks 1d6 damage. 3 rounds.
weapons.description: A dome-shaped runecaster. Calls a mud shell up around the wielder.

weapons.name: Tangle Roots
weapons.effect: Roots entangle multiple enemies (restrained, 5 rounds).
weapons.description: Heavy root-shaped runecaster. Spreads tendrils through silt floors.

weapons.name: Aetheric Disrupt
weapons.effect: Disables magical effects in a small area. 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Cracked-crystal runecaster. Severs the Aether-thread of nearby effects.

weapons.name: Mud Blast
weapons.effect: Blast of mud — damages and slows enemies. 1 round.
weapons.description: Pressurized mud-cartridge runecaster. Punches like a small cannon.

weapons.name: Barrier of Aether
weapons.effect: Creates force barrier; blocks 1d6 damage. 5 rounds.
weapons.description: Lattice-runecaster. Calls a small force-screen between caster and threat.

weapons.name: Mud Spear (Runecaster)
weapons.effect: Launches a hardened spear of mud. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Slim runecaster that forms and fires a mud spike.

weapons.name: Slow Aether
weapons.effect: Slows enemy movement by 50%. 3 rounds.
weapons.description: Aether-glass runecaster. Bends time around the target.

weapons.name: Mud Armor
weapons.effect: Covers self in mud armor; blocks 2d6 damage. 5 rounds.
weapons.description: Wide flat runecaster. Plates the wielder in living mud.

weapons.name: Aetheric Push
weapons.effect: Pushes target back 10 ft. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Force-runecaster shaped like a palm. Hits without contact.

weapons.name: Aetheric Wave
weapons.effect: Area attack — 2d6 force damage to all targets. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Wave-front runecaster. Cracks the air outward from the caster.

weapons.name: Aetheric Ward
weapons.effect: Floating Aether shield; blocks 2d6 damage. 3 rounds.
weapons.description: A small disk-runecaster. Hovers between caster and harm. Renamed from Aetheric Shield in OTA-134 — the melee Aetheric Shield is a different item.

weapons.name: Mud Torrent
weapons.effect: Flood of mud — 1d8 damage and prone. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Heavy slosh-shaped runecaster. Calls a wave of silt at the target.

weapons.name: Earthquake Ripple
weapons.effect: Minor tremors — 2d8 damage and prone. 3 rounds.
weapons.description: Stone-bowl runecaster. Sends low tremors through the floor.

weapons.name: Mud Forge
weapons.effect: Creates temporary mud weapons; last 1 encounter.
weapons.description: Anvil-shaped runecaster. Calls a brief mud-iron blade into a free hand.

weapons.name: Aetheric Shackle
weapons.effect: Binds target with energy chains (paralyzed, 3 rounds).
weapons.description: Knot-shaped runecaster. Loops Aether-chain around the target.

weapons.name: Aetheric Armor
weapons.effect: Invisible force armor; blocks 2d10 damage. 5 rounds.
weapons.description: Lattice runecaster. Plates the caster in unseen force.

weapons.name: Mud Wave
weapons.effect: Massive wave — 2d8 damage, knocks prone. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Surge-runecaster. Calls a wall of mud through the room.

weapons.name: Aetheric Pillar
weapons.effect: Raises a force pillar — 2d8 damage. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Column-shaped runecaster. Drives a force-pillar up through a target.

weapons.name: Mud Golem Creation
weapons.effect: Summons a powerful mud golem (golem stats). 10 rounds.
weapons.description: Heart-shaped runecaster. Hardens a heap of silt into a moving guardian.

weapons.name: Aetheric Collapse
weapons.effect: Causes structures to collapse on enemies. 2d8 damage. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Cracked-key runecaster. Pulls overhead structure down with a word.

weapons.name: Mud Guard
weapons.effect: Mud covers an ally — blocks 2d8 damage. 5 rounds.
weapons.description: Twin-runecaster. Plates an ally in living mud at range.

weapons.name: Displace Aether
weapons.effect: Teleports caster to a visible location. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Spiral-runecaster. Pulls the caster sideways through the Veil.

weapons.name: Aetheric Storm
weapons.effect: Storm of Aether energy — 2d10 to all enemies. 1 round.
weapons.description: Storm-glass runecaster. Calls a private Aether storm to the field.

weapons.name: Mud Emperor's Curse
weapons.effect: Curse — 2d10 damage per round. 3 rounds.
weapons.description: Royal-tier runecaster. The Mud Emperor's curse, sealed in clay.

weapons.name: Shatter Aether
weapons.effect: Breaks any magical effect or structure. Instantaneous.
weapons.description: Fracture-runecaster. Snaps Aether-binding outright.

weapons.name: Mud Army
weapons.effect: Summons an army of mud creatures (each 2d8). 1 encounter.
weapons.description: Banner-runecaster of the Mud Emperor. Calls a small army of clay-soldiers.

weapons.name: Reaver's Greatsword
weapons.effect: Notches the haft for each warband cut down.
weapons.description: Reaver's Greatsword. A shoulder-high blade of pitted Tartarian steel, the grip wrapped in cord black with old work. Heavy enough to split a Reclaimer's plate in one stroke.

weapons.name: Wyrm-Fang Blade
weapons.effect: +1d4 against beasts.
weapons.description: Wyrm-Fang Blade. A single Wyrm fang lashed to a scrap-metal hilt with spider silk. Bites deeper into thick hide than the size suggests.

weapons.name: Mud-Iron Greatblade
weapons.description: Mud-Iron Greatblade. A two-hander forged around a mud-iron heart, the spine flecked with hardened mudstone. Heavy on the draw, devastating on the landing.

weapons.name: Flame of Aether
weapons.effect: 1d6 fire; chance to ignite the target for 1 round.
weapons.description: Flame of Aether. A pocket-sized runecaster that breathes a thumb of orange flame on a held tap.

weapons.name: Gale Binder
weapons.effect: 1d6 force; pushes the target back 5 ft.
weapons.description: Gale Binder. A whistle-shaped runecaster — a thin Aetheric gust answers each pulse, hard enough to shove.

weapons.name: Sparkstrike
weapons.effect: 1d6 lightning; 1-round stun on a hit.
weapons.description: Sparkstrike. A short bronze rod with a single arc-channel. Drops the target's jaw for a beat after the hit.

weapons.name: Earthshaker
weapons.effect: 1d6 earth; knocks the target prone.
weapons.description: Earthshaker. A flat slab-runecaster — sends a ground ripple at the feet of whatever you point it at.

weapons.name: Force Wave
weapons.effect: 1d6 force; 10 ft knockback.
weapons.description: Force Wave. A palm-shaped runecaster. Hits without contact and shoves with the strike.

weapons.name: Frostbind
weapons.effect: 1d6 cold; deep chill seizes machines — bites hard into Constructs, Automations, and the frost-vulnerable.
weapons.description: Frostbind. A blue-white runecaster rimed with permanent frost — each pulse breathes a knife of cold that locks joints and cracks plate.

weapons.name: Frost Maul
weapons.effect: 1d8 cold; a two-handed rime-forged maul — seizes machinery and staggers the living.
weapons.description: Frost Maul. A heavy warhammer forged from rime-iron, its head sheathed in never-melting frost. Every swing lands a shock of cold.

weapons.name: Dark Blight
weapons.effect: 2d6 necrotic; 50% chance to apply poisoned (2 rounds).
weapons.description: Dark Blight. A dull obsidian runecaster, etched with quarantine-glyphs. Leaves a green halo on the wound.

weapons.name: Stone Fist
weapons.effect: 2d6 earth; knocks the target prone.
weapons.description: Stone Fist. A clenched-fist runecaster of carved mud-iron. A boulder-sized punch at range.

weapons.name: Ether Bolt
weapons.effect: 2d6 lightning; disables Tartarian tech in the target for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Ether Bolt. A finger-thick crystal stylus — chains blue lightning through hostile circuitry.

weapons.name: Void Pulse
weapons.effect: 2d6 void; pulls the target 5 ft closer to the caster.
weapons.description: Void Pulse. A negative-space runecaster — fires a hole in the air that nearby matter falls toward.

weapons.name: Shadow Caller
weapons.effect: 2d8 aetheric; caster turns invisible for 1 round after the hit.
weapons.description: Shadow Caller. A black-glass runecaster. The strike lands, then you aren't where you were.

weapons.name: Ember Storm
weapons.effect: 2d8 fire; 15 ft AoE, burning ground for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Ember Storm. A ribbed cylinder runecaster — exhales a fan of embers, leaves the floor glowing.

weapons.name: Stormcaller
weapons.effect: 2d8 lightning; arcs to one extra target within 10 ft.
weapons.description: Stormcaller. A bronze trident-runecaster. Calls a private squall onto whatever it's pointed at.

weapons.name: Wrath of Titans
weapons.effect: 2d20 bludgeoning; massive AoE stun + knockback (all enemies in 15 ft).
weapons.description: Wrath of Titans. A Mud Emperor-grade runecaster, cast around a Behemoth heart. The whole room reacts when it fires.

weapons.name: Phoenix Rebirth
weapons.effect: 2d20 fire; resurrects one downed ally to half HP.
weapons.description: Phoenix Rebirth. A crown-shaped runecaster set with a single Aether Wing. The fire it throws is the same fire that brings the ally back.

weapons.name: Void Edge
weapons.effect: 2d20 void; opens a damaging rift on the target tile for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Void Edge. A blade-shaped runecaster, no edge — the cut happens in the Veil. Whatever stands in the rift keeps bleeding.

weapons.name: Monarch's Court Blade
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the mud monarchs.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the mud monarchs. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Dynasty Oathspear
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the eternal dynasty.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the eternal dynasty. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Reclaimer's Salvage Maul
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the reclaimers guild. Grants +10 HP.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the reclaimers guild. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Order Reliquary Blade
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the forgotten order.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the forgotten order. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Ancestor Bone Cleaver
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the true tartarians.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the true tartarians. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Builder's Aethercraft Hammer
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the stone builders. Grants +10 HP.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the stone builders. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Giant-Watch Greatspear
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the servants of giants.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the servants of giants. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Architect's Silent Dagger
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the conspiracy architects.
weapons.description: Faction-issue melee weapon, struck for the conspiracy architects. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Revivalist Field Carbine
weapons.effect: Faction-issue armament of the tartarian revivalists.
weapons.description: Faction-issue ranged weapon, struck for the tartarian revivalists. Marked with their sigil.

weapons.name: Golem Sledge
weapons.description: A two-handed wrecking sledge sized for a construct's grip — dead weight in your hands, a wall-breaker in its. Smear it with whatever you like; the golem doesn't mind the mess.

weapons.name: Crude Golem Sledge
weapons.description: A rough wrecking sledge knocked together for a construct's grip — heavy, ugly, and enough to stave in a wall.

weapons.name: Elder Golem Sledge
weapons.description: A masterwork siege-sledge sized for a construct — perfectly balanced dead weight that turns a swing into a landslide. Takes a coating and carries it clean through.

weapons.name: Golem Greatsword
weapons.description: A scrap-forged greatsword balanced for a construct's reach. Too heavy to swing yourself; perfect for a thing that doesn't tire. Takes a coating and carries it through every swing.

weapons.name: Crude Golem Greatsword
weapons.description: A crude scrap greatsword sized for a construct's reach — no finesse, plenty of edge.

weapons.name: Elder Golem Greatsword
weapons.description: An elder greatsword balanced for a construct's tireless arm — a single sweep that shears a line clean. Holds a coating through every cut.

weapons.name: Golem Pike
weapons.description: A two-handed pike sized for a construct — a single driving thrust that punches through a guard. Coat the point and the golem carries the bite home.

weapons.name: Crude Golem Pike
weapons.description: A rough two-handed pike sized for a construct — one blunt driving thrust, and it does the job.

weapons.name: Elder Golem Pike
weapons.description: An elder driving pike sized for a construct — a single thrust that punches through any guard and out the far side. Coat the point; it rides home.

weapons.name: Golem Aether-Lance
weapons.description: A lance of bound Aether keyed to a construct's frame; it strikes with the same charge that animates the golem. Coatings ride the discharge.

weapons.name: Beacon Rifle
weapons.description: Built by breaking down the five Aether Collection Beacons and re-wiring their collector-arrays to fire instead of feed. It grabs Aether-charge out of empty air and throws it as an electrical bolt sheathed in a caustic acid load — the two elements every Tartarian machine and tower-guardian dreads most. Cannot be forged, bought, or upgraded at a Crucible.

weapons.name: Rime Spike
weapons.effect: 1d6 cold; the chill sets in the joints — the target slows and strikes late for 2 rounds.
weapons.description: Rime Spike. A stubby blue-white caster that breathes a needle of cold. It does not kill quickly. It makes a thing slow, and slow is what kills it.

weapons.name: Hoarfrost Ward
weapons.effect: Sheathes you in a shell of standing frost that cracks before you do.
weapons.description: Hoarfrost Ward. Frost grown outward in plates until it stands off the body — it takes the blow and shatters, and you walk out of the shards.

weapons.name: Killing Frost
weapons.effect: 2d8 cold; deep enough to seize a Construct's joints outright.
weapons.description: Killing Frost. The cold that comes off it is not weather. Metal goes brittle, mud goes to stone, and whatever was moving stops being able to.

weapons.name: Winter's Verdict
weapons.effect: 2d10 cold; the freeze carries through armour and holds — a sentence, not a strike.
weapons.description: Winter's Verdict. Pre-Flood judgment work. It does not argue with what it is pointed at; it simply decides the matter is closed and the cold agrees.

weapons.name: Glowrot
weapons.effect: 1d8 radiation; the wound keeps working after the light is gone.
weapons.description: Glowrot. A cracked lens over a seed of something that has not stopped burning since before the water came. Point it and the light does the rest.

weapons.name: Sickening Light
weapons.effect: 2d6 radiation; the target sickens — its attacks weaken for 3 rounds.
weapons.description: Sickening Light. A dull amber pulse that does nothing you can see, until the thing you aimed it at starts swinging like it is tired.

weapons.name: Fallout Bloom
weapons.effect: 2d6 radiation to everything close — the light opens and does not choose.
weapons.description: Fallout Bloom. It opens like a flower and it does not care whose side anyone is on. Reclaimers who carry one learn to throw it and step back.

weapons.name: Half-Life Pulse
weapons.effect: 2d10 radiation; the decay keeps going long after the pulse ends.
weapons.description: Half-Life Pulse. Whatever powers it has been dying for ten thousand years and is not finished. Neither is what it points at.
